note: Quiet-day work orders (days 1-2). Calendar day/hour. Windowed tasks only count inside their hours on their own day; other tasks latch when their check becomes true and carry over unfinished.

1.title: Morning weather readings
1.detail: Read the deck station on the west rail and log temperature, wind and sky before 11:00.

1.title: Inspect the ground transfer cabinet
1.detail: Bring the insulated service kit to the cabinet beside the compound.

1.title: Collect the reserved relay at North Ridge Supply
1.detail: Follow the logging track to the road. The relay case is on the store counter.

1.title: Afternoon smoke check
1.detail: Sight the horizon with the fire finder on the front rail between 14:00 and 18:00. Report any smoke by bearing.

1.title: Restock the stove rack to eight logs
1.detail: Mara set a dry trunk aside below the tower. Split it and stack the rack before dark.

2.title: Morning weather readings
2.detail: Read the deck station and log it before 11:00.

2.title: Fit the replacement transfer relay
2.detail: Seat the relay in the ground cabinet with your service kit.

2.title: Verify and sign off the transfer circuit
2.detail: Commission the circuit with your service tester.

2.title: Isolate the unused crew spur
2.detail: Follow Mara's timber markers to the labelled disconnect and save the 6 W standby load.

2.title: Midday smoke check
2.detail: Sight the horizon with the fire finder between 10:30 and 14:30.

smoke.reply: June: "That's Mara's crew burning slash off the logging road. Logged, thanks."

reports.all: June: "Every line ticked off. Good work, Kestrel Seven."
reports.most: June: "Most of the list done. The rest keeps until tomorrow."
reports.some: June: "A slow day. Carry the open lines over."
reports.none: June: "Nothing logged today. Call in if something's wrong up there."
